metrics.title: Plan metrics
metrics.targetsNote: Launch plan targets for the launch city: day 30 → day 90. Values below the alarm threshold are shown in red.

match.label: Match within 48 hours
match.hint: New users (last 30 days) with at least one nearby match after 48 hours: measures density.

wau.label: Weekly active users
wau.hint: People who used the app in the last 7 days.

trades.label: Trades completed per week
trades.hint: Confirmed by both parties in the app, last 7 days.

retention.label: Return after 4 weeks
retention.hint: Users who joined 4–8 weeks ago and used the app from day 28 onwards.

stores.label: Active stores
stores.hint: Verified, with at least 50 cards available or an event in the last 30 days.

broadcasts.label: "I'm here" alerts per week
broadcasts.hint: Sent in the last 7 days: shows whether sellers use the app outside stores.

safety.intro: Messages blocked by the chat filter and reports about minors or illegal proposals. Those involving a minor come first. Anyone with 2 serious reports in 30 days has their chat suspended for 7 days pending your review.
safety.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate @{{username}}'s account? They won't be able to sign in.
safety.legal: If you suspect grooming of a minor, besides deactivating the account keep the data and report it to the Polizia Postale (commissariatodips.it).

kinds.Illegal: Illegal content or not about cards
kinds.ContactToMinor: Contacts asked from or given to a minor

users.title: Users
users.intro: Find a user, change their profile type and manage account and chat. Every change is kept in the log.

profileHints.Collector: All base features: collection, wishlist, matches, trades, chat, events.
profileHints.Seller: Plus: stall showcase with QR and 8 "I'm here" posts a day.
profileHints.Store: Plus: loyalty card, local demand, buylist, reserve & collect, exhibitors, Store badge.
profileHints.Organizer: Plus: exhibitors and floor plan on their events, 8 "I'm here" posts a day.
